question.text: A spherical convex surface of power 5 dioptre separates object and image space of refractive indices $1.0$ and $\frac{4}{3}$ respectively. The radius of curvature of the surface is

solution.text: $P=5 D$ $u=\infty$ then $\frac{1}{\infty}-\frac{4 / 3}{f}=\frac{1-4 / 3}{R}$ $-\frac{4}{3 f}=-\frac{1}{3 R}$ $\frac{f}{4}=R \quad \quad f=4 R$ $\therefore \frac{100}{5}=4 R \Rightarrow R=\frac{25}{5}=5 \mathrm{~cm}$
